1. Overview
Poln8 is a cross-platform mobile application that gives customers one place to manage their loyalty
balance and stored-value gift cards: sign in, load funds, present a card code at the store, send e-gift
cards, find stores and products, and manage payment methods, all from an Android or iOS phone.
The app is driven by the server. On start-up it reads the brand’s group configuration (colours, fonts, logo,
language and feature switches), applies any state or age restriction, checks whether a newer app version
is available, and then offers sign-in or account creation. Customer, card, payment and transaction
operations are carried out through the Mobile web API and the Synergy services behind it.
The application is built on .NET 8 and .NET MAUI using the MVVM pattern, with shared API, core and
entity libraries. Bank (ACH) funding is supported through Hypur or AeroPay, and an optional Rallio
integration links the customer’s account to an external service.
2. Business Context
Brands that run loyalty and stored-value gift card programmes typically need to:
• Give customers one place to see their loyalty points and gift card balances
• Let customers reload a gift card and pay from it in store using a scannable code
• Accept several ways to fund a card: credit card, bank (ACH), crypto currency and partner payments
• Offer promotions and promo codes, e-gift cards, and shared access through authorized users
• Help customers find participating stores and browse the product catalogue

• Keep the app on-brand, in the customer’s language and inside regional restrictions, without a new
release for every change
Poln8 brings these needs into a single branded mobile app, backed by a shared services platform that
controls appearance, language and features per brand.

4. Functional Modules
4.1 Account Creation & Secure Login

• New customers register with name, email, phone and password, then confirm a validation code before
completing the account

• Returning customers sign in with email or phone and password; Face ID or fingerprint sign-in is
offered when the brand enables it and the device supports it

• Saved sign-in values are AES-256 encrypted, and Logout clears them; forgot-password and change-
password flows are provided
4.2 Loyalty & Gift Card Wallet

• A home screen presents the customer’s loyalty balance and gift cards, with separate Pay with Gift
Card and Pay with Loyalty screens

• Each card can be shown as a QR code for scanning at the store, with its transaction history and
balance

• Cards can be added by number, and a gift card can be added to Google Wallet (Android) or exported
as an Apple Wallet pass (iOS)
4.3 Load Funds & Payment Methods

• A gift card is loaded with a saved credit card or bank (ACH) account; payment methods are added,
activated and set as default from My Payments

• Bank accounts are linked through a bank-linking screen with Hypur authorization; the ACH gateway is
chosen from the merchant’s e-gift settings (AeroPay or Hypur)

• Crypto loading shows the exchange rate, amount and address to pay; a ColumbiaCare option and
billing address management are available when enabled
4.4 Auto Load, Promotions & Transfers

• Auto Load settings reload a card by a chosen amount when its balance falls below a set threshold,
using a saved payment method

• When the brand allows client coupons, registration asks whether the customer has a promo code, and
promo codes can also be applied from the Promotions menu

4.5 E-Gift Cards & Rallio Integration

• Send E-Gift Card in the menu opens the brand’s e-gift page in the browser, adding the customer’s
identifier to the link when e-gift wallet pay is allowed

• When the Rallio integration is enabled, a Rallio user is created as the account is completed and the
Rallio customer ID is saved to the customer record
• A Home button, named by the brand, opens the customer’s Rallio link generated by the Rallio service
4.6 Store Locator & Product Catalog
• Stores are listed using the customer’s location, with a store details page showing a map pin
• Directions to a store are drawn on the map using Google Maps services
• A Products page lists the brand’s products with their images
4.7 Authorized Users & Profile Management
• Account owners can add authorized users and review the list of users with access
• Profile details and dynamic fields can be updated, and passwords changed
• A customer can delete their account from the profile screen
4.8 Branding, Localization & Support

• Colours, fonts, corner radius, logo size, banner and footer settings come from the brand’s group
configuration and are applied at start-up

• The interface is localized through resource files in English and Spanish (Mexico), selected by the
brand’s language setting

• An update prompt appears when a newer app version is published; Contact Us, About, How It Works
and Legal pages complete the support content, and location and age checks can block or gate access

6. System Architecture & Integrations
The solution contains the mobile app, shared libraries and the server-side APIs:

• Mobile app: MobilePolneightMaui, a single .NET MAUI project with XAML pages, MVVM view
models, converters, behaviors and a Shell flyout menu

• Shared libraries: Mobile.App.Api (service clients and HTTP helper), Mobile.App.Core (validation
helpers), Mobile.App.Entities (request and response models), Mobile.App.Logging and KAM.Core

• Web APIs: Mobile.App.Auth.WebApi issues JWT tokens and serves group, validation-code and
customer endpoints; Mobile.App.WebApi serves group information; PKPassGenerator.WebApi
supports wallet passes

• Data layer: Mobile.App.Data uses Entity Framework Core and Dapper on SQL Server (SynergyAdmin
and MobileApp databases) for customers, cards, payments, reloads, promo codes, redemptions and
Hypur tokens

• Payment and partner services: Hypur and AeroPay for bank payments, ForumPay for crypto
loading, ColumbiaCare for partner payments, Rallio, Google Pay and Apple Wallet pass generation

• Platform services: Google Maps geocoding, directions and place search; device location, browser
launcher and email; email and SMS helpers in KAM.Core

8. Security & Data Handling

• The Auth Web API issues JWT bearer tokens (issuer and audience validation, signing key, lifetime
checks) with refresh-token support and an admin-only impersonation endpoint

• Customer credentials are validated against the Synergy customer records; new accounts and
password resets are confirmed with validation codes

• Saved email, phone and password values on the device are AES-256 encrypted, and Logout clears
the stored values
• Face ID and fingerprint sign-in is optional and enabled per brand through the group configuration

• Hypur access tokens are kept per customer on the server and refreshed automatically when they
expire
• Location and age checks can restrict access by state or require an age confirmation before sign-in

• Payment card and bank details are entered in the app and sent to the server; card numbers are
validated on the client
9. Value Delivered
• Gives customers a single, unified wallet for loyalty rewards and stored value
• Removes the need for a physical card by presenting scannable codes and wallet passes

• Increases card usage through flexible loading: card, bank, crypto, auto load, promo codes and e-gift
cards
• Lets each brand control look, language and features from the server, without a new app release
• Keeps customers current with an in-app prompt when a newer version is available
• Extends account flexibility with authorized users and balance transfers
• Improves reach with store discovery and optional Rallio account linking
